facts.claim: A traveller can rest safely at Greenspring.
Greenspring sells goods and services to travellers.
Greenspring gives shelter for the night.
Greenspring offers services to travellers.
A player can buy and sell at Greenspring.
Greenspring is a tribe's village beside the Panther Race, built on springs whose water can be drunk unboiled.
The tribe's Hist grows over the spring.
Clean water rises from a stone lip on firm ground.
The spring is a short walk from the road and from the river landing.
The tribe serves travellers bound for Helstrom.
The tribe charges nothing for water.
The tribe charges a great deal for beds and rope.
Salt is reaching the water from upstream.
The Hist has begun to sicken.
The village blames the salt works for the salt in the water.
Traffic for Helstrom brings cult couriers, tappers and the Veiled Reed's factors.
Visitors are expected to taste the water from the pool under the Hist before they speak.
Huts stand round the spring.
A hide tent stands beside the spring.
The village is built of mud-walled pods and bamboo huts.
The landing has no plank stage.
Painted urns stand along the yards.
The yards used daily are well kept and the ground a step off the path is threadbare.
A small clear pool lies under the Hist.
The village keeps provisions for guests it half-trusts, which give shelter.
A quest can settle the spring's use in writing, or foul it.
Water here can be drunk without ceremony.
The tribe charges nothing for the water.
Beds and rope cost a great deal.
The village is hospitable and tired.
Cold mineral water is tasted before a word is spoken.
Wet rope and boat tar smell at the landing.
Voices barter over bed and rope prices.
Frond smoke drifts from the cookfires at dusk.
If the spring soured, the village would have to move to find a new source of fresh water.
Travellers bound for Helstrom would then lose their surest clean water.
A body lies in the water of Greenspring's spring.
Two households at the spring would rather the body in the spring was not raised.
Two convocation delegations lodge at Greenspring rather than pay the pitch rent at Nine-Trunks.
Nine-Trunks rents convocation pitch to delegations at a high rate.
A Root Steward of Hissmir lodges at Greenspring and will give the Trial of the Burnished Scales to anyone who comes.
